text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The mountain of work that had piled up day after day has finally settled down a bit...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I dragged my heavy body to the shopping district
to buy something tasty as a reward, and then—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a moment there, Trainer,
wait right there!
choice_data_list: Nature...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sigh. I knew you were busy with work,
but pushing yourself until you're staggering is just too much.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped, so big sister Nature will treat ya.
Come on, over here.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
We're still getting ready to open, so there won't be any customers yet.
Why don't you have a seat in the karaoke booth in the back?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where Nice Nature brought me to
was a corner of a certain shop.
choice_data_list: This is...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's an acquaintance's mom's shop. I explained the situation and she said we could use it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'll whip up something light, so just wait a bit. ...Though I can't guarantee how it'll taste.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few minutes later, Nice Nature
brought over some fried rice she made.
choice_data_list: Is it really okay to take this much?
Is it really okay to take this much?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Mom also said,
'Let them eat as much as they want.'

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Come now, hurry and eat up
before it gets cold."
choice_data_list: Amazing, it looks just like a restaurant menu!
Amazing, it looks like a restaurant menu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fried rice served to me looked amazing, but it tasted
even better—so delicious that my chopsticks... or rather,
my spoon just couldn't stop.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're exaggerating. It's just that I used to help my mom out
ever since I was little, so I know how to cook.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, that was fast!
You're done eating already?!
choice_data_list: It was so delicious, I just couldn't help myself

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, it's fine. You were starving, right?
I'll take care of it, just pass me your plate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I watched Nice Nature's back as she walked away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to being so full, an overwhelming sleepiness washed over me,
and my consciousness gradually drifted away—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...La... lala...âª

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Lalala...âª

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!
Did I wake you up by any chance!?
choice_data_list: ...What about that song?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's a song Mom used to sing behind the bar counter all the time.
Though I don't really know much about it myself.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I was reminiscing about the past
and ended up humming without thinking... Sorry about that, okay?
choice_data_list: If anything, I wanted to hear more.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Come now~. Flattery like that
won't work on your good old Nature, you know?"
choice_data_list: It's true that I love Nice Nature's songs, after all.
With singing like that, the live show will be perfect!
With singing like that, the live show will be perfect!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Come now~. Flattery like that
won't work on your good old Nature, you know?"
choice_data_list: It's true that I love Nice Nature's songs, after all.
With singing like that, the live show will be perfect!
With singing like that, the live show will be perfect!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh, is that so?
You really are an odd one, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I'm relieved you didn't say 'good at it.'
'Like' is such a convenient word, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No one will compare me to others and be disappointed,
and I won't disappoint myself by failing expectations either.
choice_data_list: Nature...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha.
Sorry I can't say anything cute.
choice_data_list: I love that side of you too, Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Y-You... idiot!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If you say things like that too much,
they kinda lose their weight, you know?

text_block_list.name: Bar Hostess
text_block_list.text: Are you ready to head back, Nei-chan?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Mom.
You were a huge help.

text_block_list.name: Bar Hostess
text_block_list.text:
"So the one beside you is the rumored Trainer.
I've heard plenty about you from Nei-chan—"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Geez! Forget about that stuff! Let's go, Trainer!
choice_data_list: ...Rumors?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Here... we... go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, under the warm gaze of the owner, the two of us left the shop.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~... After working this hard,
you're still thinking about the concert?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "I've been thinking about this for a while now, but aren't you pushing yourself way too hard, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If I don't keep an eye on you like this,
you look like you're gonna collapse.
choice_data_list: I don't think that's true, though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, you see, that's just how it is~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait a moment.
I'll make you some extra rice balls.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"You're just going to end up doing work
after you get home anyway, aren't you?"
choice_data_list: So you found out, huh?
You knew?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, you two! Stop pretending you don't agree!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, after receiving a loving scolding
and a late-night snack from Nice Nature,
I headed out of the shop.
